alerting.description:
Whether detections resulting from this deployment should be considered
alerts.
alerting.rationale: Enabling alerting ensures that important security detections are not silently ignored and are surfaced for investigation.

archived.description:
The archive state of the rule deployment.
Cannot be set to true unless enabled is set to false i.e.
archiving requires a two-step process: first, disable the rule by
setting 'enabled' to false, then set 'archive' to true.
If set to true, alerting will automatically be set to false.
If currently set to true, enabled, alerting, and run_frequency cannot be
updated.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is currently deployed continuously against incoming data.

instance.description: The unique identifier for the Chronicle instance, which is the same as the customer ID.

location.description: The location of the resource. This is the geographical region where the Chronicle instance resides, such as "us" or "europe-west2".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

rule.description: The Rule ID of the rule.

run_frequency.description:
The run frequency of the rule deployment.
Possible values:
LIVE
HOURLY
DAILY
